rationale: Cross-sectional equity paper using CRSP/Compustat (Jan 1968 - Dec 2022). Clear methodology: decile/univariate portfolio sorts on MAX and MAX^beta, dependent double sorts for beta-neutralization, bivariate sorts on mispricing characteristics and MAX, Fama-MacBeth cross-sectional regressions, and factor model alphas (CAPM/FF3/FFC4/FFCPS/FF5/FF6/FF6PS/SY/DHS). Reports quantitative results in Tables 1-10 plus Internet Appendix Tables A1-A12. Sample period, data sources, and variable operationalizations are explicitly specified.
